Duleep Trophy Final Squads Announced, Key Players to Feature

The squads for the Duleep Trophy final have been announced, with several prominent young cricketers set to participate. Tilak Varma expressed excitement about playing at Chepauk. Vaibhav Sooryavanshi and Ishan are also listed to play, while KL Rahul will not be part of the final. Mohammed Siraj is reportedly seeking to regain form. The final match is scheduled to feature key players like Devdutt Padikkal and Vaibhav Sooryavanshi.
